title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be the Same Man in the Dark as You Are in the Light
caption:
The man in the dark is the real version of you. Not the one who shows up for church.

Check the version nobody's grading. Close the gap on purpose. Let one brother see both sides of you, because a secret that never sees light doesn't get smaller. It gets louder.

The goal was never a flawless record. It's one man, in the same words, on the same day.

#biblicalmanhood #christianmen #integrity #godlyman #brotherhood
